product.olivetti-m30030p.summary: 50 MHz i486DX2 performance variant of the M300-30, using a 25 MHz external bus.
product.olivetti-m30030p.history: M300-30P retains the M300-30 platform, but its DX2/50 CPU warrants a separate machine identity and configuration.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.verif: BIOS 1.09/Diagnostics 2.00 completes resident diagnostics at 4 MB and reports 640 KB base + 3072 KB extended + 384 KB dedicated = 4096 KB.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.limit: Partial bootable emulation with the same chipset, video and Super I/O boundaries as M300-30. Diagnostics 2.00 labels the configured DX2/50 as DX2-66. Ctrl+Alt+Del can halt during early firmware initialisation, after the memory count or at a blinking cursor; use a hard reset for now. CPU timing identification, other RAM populations and a wider software set remain to be validated.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.manua: Olivetti service guide chapter 36; primary source for M300-30 and M300-30P.
